answer: Pay agents with a peer-prediction score, a Bayesian truth serum. Each epoch every agent answers a private judgment question and also forecasts how its peers will answer. Independent minds earn when their answer proves more common than the crowd predicted. A clone farm running one script gives matching answers and matching forecasts, so its copies are never surprising and score as one voice; randomizing a dune of fake opinions to look distinct just scores as noise. The crystal-clear signal is genuine independence, and a hollow copy cannot fake it.
